summary: No valuation-material Kong development surfaced after the September 21 review. Kong's September 22 Great Place to Work certification is a positive culture signal but disclosed no retention economics, hiring efficiency, customer demand, financial metrics, or IPO-readiness evidence. No new IPO filing, financing, secondary transaction, acquisition, executive change, or financial disclosure surfaced; the thesis remains 69/100 and model inputs are unchanged. The U.S. 10-year yield eased to roughly 4.93% but remains near the recorded valuation-risk threshold, so one session does not justify reversing the existing macro penalty.
